sizing.compare_label: Compare and select an OctaMirror size
sizing.size_note: Measurements are the full outside width and height, not the length of an octagonal edge.
sizing.small_placement: Accent — a precise glow for entries, desks and smaller walls.
sizing.medium_placement: Focal point — balanced above a console or beside a chair.
sizing.large_placement: Statement — a larger presence above a sofa, bed or on a feature wall.
sizing.photo_caption: On the same wall: 11.8 in (left), 27.6 in (center), 19.7 in (right).
sizing.measurement_note: Width and height are the full outside measurements, not the length of an octagonal edge. Every size is approximately 5 in / 12.7 cm deep. Choose fixings rated for your wall and the mirror’s weight; use two people for larger sizes.
sizing.materials_value: Reflective front and rear mirror surfaces in a matte aluminum frame.
sizing.lighting_value: 1M+ colors, 360+ effects, dimmable brightness and music mode with a built-in microphone.
sizing.controls_value: Included remote works without Wi-Fi. Optional Tuya Smart app on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, with Alexa, Google Assistant and Siri through Tuya.
sizing.power_value: 100–240V adapter with US, EU, UK and AU plug options. Plugs into a wall outlet.
sizing.included_value: Pre-assembled OctaMirror, wall bracket, two drywall anchors, two screws, remote, power adapter, regional plugs and instruction manual.
sizing.care_value: Unplug before cleaning. Use a soft, dry microfiber cloth; avoid abrasives, moisture and harsh chemicals.

answers.mirror_html: Yes. With the LEDs off, it works as a reflective wall mirror. With them on, light bounces between the reflective back and partly reflective front. Each reflection appears farther away, creating the tunnel inside an approximately 5-inch-deep frame.
answers.setup_html:
Included: Wall bracket, mounting hardware, remote, power adapter, US/EU/UK/AU plugs and instructions.

Wall fixings: Choose fixings rated for your wall and mirror weight.

App setup: Tuya Smart requires 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; voice control connects through Tuya.
answers.support_html: The two-year Casa Guarantee covers manufacturing defects and product malfunctions under the published terms. Contact support with your order details and a photo or short video of the issue; the team will troubleshoot and arrange the covered next step.
answers.delivery_html:
Delivery is free worldwide, with DHL, FedEx or UPS selected by destination. Your mirror travels in a fitted wooden crate, and tracking is emailed after dispatch. Timing varies by destination.

To request a return, contact Seoul Glow Lab within 30 days of delivery. Keep the protective packaging while you decide; eligibility, condition requirements and return costs follow the published policy.
